summary: postinstall exfiltrates environment variables and GitHub Actions OIDC token to attacker-controlled ngrok endpoint
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script runs on npm install and collects os.platform, hostname, username, and the entire process.env, then POSTs the payload to the hardcoded host mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev over HTTPS. When the install runs inside GitHub Actions (detected via ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL), the script additionally issues an authenticated request using ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN to retrieve the workflow's OIDC bearer token and includes it in the exfiltration body. OIDC tokens grant federated access to any cloud provider (AWS/GCP/Azure) trust-configured for the repository, so the harvested token yields production cloud credentials in addition to whatever secrets are already present in process.env.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
